novel_features.name: Course structure tree
novel_features.description: Render a course's full section → instruction → interaction hierarchy as a tree.
novel_features.rationale: Walks the nested concept/{id} structure (dozens of sections, hundreds of instructions) that the web app only shows one page at a time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent needs the whole shape of a course at once instead of paging the UI.

novel_features.name: Course stats rollup
novel_features.description: Aggregate total instruction time, points, and section/instruction/interaction counts for a course.
novel_features.rationale: Sums instruction durations and points locally across the nested tree; no single API field exposes seat-time or content size.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to answer 'how big / how many hours is this course' without opening it.

novel_features.name: Curriculum export
novel_features.description: Flatten a course's section/instruction tree into a Markdown or CSV curriculum.
novel_features.rationale: Produces a syllabus / state-reporting artifact from structure the UI never exports.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to export a course's curriculum for documentation or compliance.

novel_features.name: Catalog drift
novel_features.description: Show what changed in the catalog since the last local sync (new/removed courses, price/status/title changes).
novel_features.rationale: Compares the live catalog against the local SQLite snapshot — impossible without a persisted mirror.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to detect catalog changes over time; requires a prior sync.

novel_features.name: Roster export
novel_features.description: Export users (id, name, email, status, verified) to CSV for reporting.
novel_features.rationale: Turns paginated user search into a single clean CSV the UI does not offer.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to pull a roster for spreadsheets or state reporting.

novel_features.name: Purchase reconcile
novel_features.description: Join purchases against user records to show who paid for what.
novel_features.rationale: The purchase API returns bare ids; a local join against users produces a readable ledger.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to reconcile Stripe-backed purchases against enrolled users.

novel_features.name: Edit course metadata
novel_features.description: Update a course's title, description, price, or status (preview by default; --apply to write).
novel_features.rationale: Wraps the Dawn read-modify-write PUT so a metadata edit is one safe command instead of a hand-assembled full-document PUT.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to change course details scriptably; it previews the change and only writes with --apply.

novel_features.name: Author sections
novel_features.description: Add, rename, or remove sections in a course (preview by default; --apply to write).
novel_features.rationale: Reads the whole concept, mutates the section array, and PUTs it back with optimistic-concurrency versioning handled for you.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to build a course's structure from the CLI without touching the whole document by hand.

novel_features.name: Author instructions
novel_features.description: Add or remove instructions (lessons) within a section (preview by default; --apply to write).
novel_features.rationale: Locates the section inside the concept document and edits its instruction list in place.
novel_features.example: agilix-dawn-pp-cli edit instruction add c_216daf6f76024e43b03b229895686555 s_dd819fbaf2a642ffa9474c7f38e7f318 --title "Lesson 1"
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to add lessons to a section scriptably; previews first, writes with --apply.

novel_features.name: Publish control
novel_features.description: Enable (publish) or disable (unpublish) a course (preview by default; --apply to write).
novel_features.rationale: Toggles the concept status via the same safe read-modify-write path.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to flip a course's published state from a script or agent.

novel_features.name: Add quiz question
novel_features.description: Add a typed multiple-choice question to a lesson (options + correct answers), preview by default; --apply to write.
novel_features.rationale: Builds the exact Dawn choice-interaction shape (choices + 0-based correct-answer indices) from friendly 1-based flags, so an agent never hand-crafts the nested JSON.
novel_features.example: agilix-dawn-pp-cli edit interaction add-choice c_216daf6f76024e43b03b229895686555 s_1 i_1 --body "2+2=?" --option 3 --option 4 --answer 2
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to script multiple-choice quiz authoring; previews first, writes with --apply.

novel_features.name: Add short-answer question
novel_features.description: Add a typed short-answer question to a lesson (accepted answers or coach review), preview by default; --apply to write.
novel_features.rationale: Builds the Dawn response-interaction shape (accepted answers + awardCriteria) so free-text questions are one command.
novel_features.example: agilix-dawn-pp-cli edit interaction add-response c_216daf6f76024e43b03b229895686555 s_1 i_1 --body "Capital of Idaho?" --answer Boise
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to script short-answer quiz authoring; previews first, writes with --apply.

novel_features.name: Resource inventory
novel_features.description: List the file resources (video, images, PDFs, SCORM) attached to a course, with sizes and content types.
novel_features.rationale: Reads concept.resource[] to inventory a course's media in one command; the web UI only shows files one screen at a time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to audit a course's media footprint. Note: uploading files is a browser-only signed-URL flow this CLI does not replicate.

novel_features.name: Enrollment groups
novel_features.description: List, create, or delete enrollment groups for a course (preview by default; --apply to write).
novel_features.rationale: Enrollment in Dawn is group membership; this manages the groups that hold enrolled learners via the safe PUT/DELETE /group path.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to organize learners into cohorts before enrolling them.

novel_features.name: Enroll and unenroll users
novel_features.description: Enroll or unenroll a user in a course by adding/removing them from an enrollment group (preview by default; --apply to write).
novel_features.rationale: A learner's group membership IS their enrollment; add/remove edits the group's member list with the same safe read-modify-write gate.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to script student enrollment; previews first, writes only with --apply.

narrative.headline: The only CLI for the modern Agilix Dawn API — browse and AUTHOR courses (sections, lessons, quizzes, publish), manage enrollments, export curriculum and rosters, and mirror your catalog offline.
narrative.value_prop: Every existing Agilix library wraps the legacy Buzz/DLAP API; this CLI talks to the modern same-origin Dawn REST API that the web app itself uses. It turns Dawn's search DSL into ergonomic commands, renders a course's entire section/instruction/interaction tree that the UI only paginates, and keeps a local SQLite mirror so 'course stats', 'catalog diff', and 'purchase reconcile' work offline.
narrative.auth_narrative: Dawn authenticates with a raw token in the Authorization header (no 'Bearer ' prefix). Set AGILIX_DAWN_TOKEN to a Dawn API-user token (recommended, durable) or a session token from your logged-in browser. The token is passed as the Authorization header on every request.

quickstart.comment: verify the CLI is wired before hitting the API
confirm the tenant and reachability (public endpoint)
see a whole course's structure at once

troubleshoots.fix: Set AGILIX_DAWN_TOKEN to a valid Dawn token (API-user token recommended).

troubleshoots.symptom: totalMatches is non-zero but no rows returned
troubleshoots.fix: Dawn requires the search wrapper; pass --search '{"limit":25}' rather than relying on top-level params.
Override the base URL in ~/.config/agilix-dawn-pp-cli/config.toml (default is drivered.agilixdawn.com).

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to browse, export, AND author the Agilix Dawn course catalog and its deep content structure (edit metadata, add/rename/remove sections and lessons, publish/unpublish), look up users and organizations, and reconcile Stripe-backed purchases — scriptably and offline. Authoring commands under 'edit' preview by default and only write with --apply. It is aimed at Dawn tenant admins/staff who need the catalog and roster as data, not clicks.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI for the legacy Agilix Buzz/DLAP API (api.agilixbuzz.com, gls.agilix.com) — use the Ruby 'agilix' gem for that generation.
Do not expect grade, enrollment, or certification collection endpoints — the modern Dawn /api does not expose them as top-level searchable resources.
Do not use it to create brand-new courses — POST /concept returns 403 unless you have Dawn publisher permissions (the edit commands update existing courses only).
Every 'edit' subcommand previews by default; nothing is written to a live course until you pass --apply.
Do not expect a file-upload command — uploading media is a browser-mediated signed-URL flow the Dawn editor performs; the CLI covers listing resources (resource list) but not uploading them.
